name: Synthesize When Evidence Collected
description: When a researcher loop accumulates a research.has_evidence triple (written by rule 02), spawn a synthesizer. The synthesizer receives the researcher's loop id and uses read_loop_result to page through the findings — no inline content carried by the rule. See ADR-028.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.synthesis
on_enter.prompt:
You are a research synthesizer. A researcher has finished in loop $entity.id. Call read_loop_result with loop_id=$entity.id to fetch the findings (page through with the offset metadata if the result is long). Then produce a structured synthesis with:

1. Summary (2-3 sentences)
2. Key Findings (numbered, with source attribution if the researcher cited any)
3. Confidence Assessment (well-supported vs. uncertain)
4. Gaps (what is still unknown)

Additional context: query the graph for entities with predicate research.has_evidence to discover other related findings from parallel researchers on the same topic.
